question:
The following bar graph shows the circulation growth of a magazine ABC from July 2022 to December 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10136dbb60f5a0e58e312e5ff4fa2bc0bc090002e65f10f31c01740e65a9e1e0.png] 

During October to December there was an even growth rate, the average of which, is (correct up to one decimal place):
solution:
**Given:**

October: 200,189

November: 204,933

December: 211,885

**Formula used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 + r)ⁿ

Where:

r = Monthly growth rate (as a decimal)

n = Number of months (in this case, n = 2 months)

Final Value = December value (211,885)

Initial Value = October value (200,189)

**Calculations:**

211,885 = 200,189 × (1 + r)²

⇒ (1 + r)² = 211,885 / 200,189

⇒ (1 + r)² = 1.0586

⇒ 1 + r = √1.0586 ≈ 1.029

⇒ r = 1.029 - 1 = 0.029

⇒ r ≈ 0.029, or 2.9%

**∴ The average growth rate is 2.9%.**
